test_hammings_all_pairs: test faiss.hammings to compute all-pairs Hamming distances between two sets of binary codes
test_hammings_knn_mc: test faiss.hammings_knn_mc to find k-nearest neighbors using Hamming distance on binary codes
test_hamming_count_thres: test faiss.hamming_count_thres to count pairs of binary codes within a Hamming distance threshold
test_match_hamming_thres: test faiss.match_hamming_thres to find all matching pairs of binary codes within a Hamming threshold
test_generalized_hammings_knn_hc: test faiss.generalized_hammings_knn_hc to find k-nearest neighbors using generalized Hamming distance with a heap collector
